enDef: if something is half one thing and half something else, it is a combination of those two things

example.en: He’s half English, half Swiss.
example.cn: 他有一半英格兰血统，一半瑞士血统。

cn: 门厅； 礼堂， 会堂； 办公大楼
enDef: a building or large room for public events such as meetings or dances

example.en: a concert at Carnegie Hall
example.cn: 卡内基音乐厅的一场音乐会

cn: [hung-hung] 悬挂， 吊； 徘徊； [hanged-hanged] 吊
enDef: to put something in a position so that the top part is fixed or supported, and the bottom part is free to move and does not touch the ground

example.en: Philip hung his coat on a hook behind the door.
example.cn: 菲利普把自己的大衣挂在门后的钩子上。

enDef: the general condition of your body and how healthy you are

example.en: I’m worried about my husband’s health.
example.cn: 我担心我丈夫的健康状况。

enDef: to give something to someone else with your hand

example.en: To communicate with her, you have to spell words out on her hand.
example.cn: 跟她交流，你必须把字一个个地在她手心里拼写出来。

enDef: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about

example.en: ‘Where’s Paul?’ ‘He’s gone to the cinema.’
example.cn: “保罗在哪儿？”“他去看电影了。”

enDef: an activity that you enjoy doing in your free time

example.en: What are your hobbies?
example.cn: 你有些什么爱好？

enDef: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

example.en: a huge dog
example.cn: 一条大狗

cn: 坚硬的， 坚固的； 困难的， 艰苦的； 勤勉的， 刻苦
enDef: firm, stiff, and difficult to press down, break, or cut

example.en: a hard wooden chair
example.cn: 一把硬木椅

enDef: Someone's hometown is the town where they live or the town that they come from

example.en: Do you like your hometown?
example.cn: 你喜欢你的家乡吗？

enDef: to dislike something very much

example.en: It’s the kind of movie you either love or hate.
example.cn: 这是那种你要么喜欢要么讨厌的电影。

enDef: almost not

example.en: My parents divorced when I was six, and I hardly knew my father.
example.cn: 我六岁时父母离婚，我对父亲几乎一无所知。

enDef: how tall someone or something is

example.en: Sam’s about the same height as his sister now.
example.cn: 萨姆现在身高和他姐姐差不多了。

enDef: the place where God is believed to live and where good people are believed to go when they die

example.en: He looked up towards the heavens.
example.cn: 他仰望苍穹。

enDef: a time of rest from work, school etc

example.en: The school holidays start tomorrow.
example.cn: 学校假期从明天开始。

enDef: completely

example.en: I’m not a hundred percent sure where she lives.
example.cn: 我不能完全确定她住在哪里。

cn: 她（she的宾格）；她的（she的所有格）；她（指某个国家；一艘船）
enDef: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about

example.en: Jane? I don’t really know her.
example.cn: 简？我不太认识她。

cn: 有； 进行， 从事； 享受， 经受； 使， 让； 必须， 不得不
enDef: used with past participles to form perfect tenses

example.en: Our guests have arrived.
example.cn: 我们的客人到了。

cn: 住宅；家庭；机构；议会；某种用途的建筑物
enDef: a group of people who make the laws of a country

example.en: The president will address both houses of Congress.
example.cn: 总统将向参众两院发表讲话。

cn: 家，住宅；产地；家乡；避难所
enDef: the house, apartment, or place where you live

example.en: They have a beautiful home in California.
example.cn: 他们在加州有个美丽的家。

enDef: in this place

example.en: What are you doing here?
example.cn: 你们在这里干什么？

enDef: the upper part of a pig’s leg, or the meat from this that has been preserved with salt or smoke

example.en: a ham sandwich
example.cn: 火腿三明治

enDef: a piece of clothing that you wear on your head

example.en: Maria was wearing a beautiful new hat.
example.cn: 玛丽亚戴着一顶漂亮的新帽子。

example.en: That should be his mother.
example.cn: 那大概是他的母亲。

cn: 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的；阴沉的
enDef: weighing a lot

example.en: The wardrobe was too heavy for me to move on my own.
example.cn: 衣橱太重，我一个人移不动。

cn: 快乐的， 愉快的； 幸福的； 令人满意的
enDef: having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life

example.en: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
example.cn: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

enDef: an adult female chicken

example.en: She does not like the hen that pecks all day.
example.cn: 她不喜欢这个整天啄来啄去的母鸡。

enDef: a shout used to get someone’s attention or to show surprise, interest, or annoyance

example.en: Hey, wait a minute!
example.cn: 喂，等一下！

cn: 无论如何；不管怎样（接副词或形容词）；然而；可是
enDef: used when you are adding a fact or piece of information that seems surprising, or seems very different from what you have just said

example.en: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
example.cn: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法，不过有危险。

enDef: the man that a woman is married to

example.en: Have you met my husband Roy?
example.cn: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

enDef: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about

example.en: Are you in love with him?
example.cn: 你爱上他了吗？

cn: [hit-hit; hitting] 打， 击中； 碰撞
enDef: to touch someone or something quickly and hard with your hand, a stick etc

example.en: He raised the hammer and hit the bell.
example.cn: 他举起钟锤敲钟。

enDef: work that you do to take care of a house, for example washing, cleaning etc

example.en: Men are doing more housework nowadays.
example.cn: 现今男人正在承担越来越多的家务。

enDef: a large building where sick or injured people receive medical treatment

example.en: They are building a new hospital.
example.cn: 他们正在建一家新医院。

cn: 热的；辣的；热情的；激动的；紧迫的
enDef: food that tastes hot has a burning taste because it contains strong spices

example.en: a hot curry
example.cn: 一种辛辣的咖喱

cn: 使加快，催促；急运，急派；匆忙，赶紧
enDef: to do something or go somewhere more quickly than usual, especially because there is not much time

example.en: If we hurry, we’ll get there in time.
example.cn: 要是赶紧的话，我们能及时到那里。

cn: 发生； 碰巧， 恰好
enDef: when something happens, there is an event, especially one that is not planned

example.en: When did the accident happen?
example.cn: 事故什么时候发生的？

cn: 怎么， 怎样； 多么， 多少
enDef: used to ask or talk about the way in which something happens or is done

example.en: How do you spell your name?
example.cn: 你的名字怎么拼写？

enDef: a building where people pay to stay and eat meals

example.en: I’ve booked the flights and the hotel.
example.cn: 我已订好机票和酒店。

enDef: a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour, and 24 hours in one day.

example.en: The interview will last about two hours.
example.cn: 面试大概要持续两小时。

cn: [held-held] 拿， 握； 使保持某种状态；
enDef: to make something stay in a particular position

example.en: Lift your head off the floor and hold this position for five seconds.
example.cn: 把头抬离地面，保持这个姿势五秒钟。

enDef: a feeling of wanting something to happen or be true and believing that it is possible or likely

example.en: When I first arrived in New York, I was full of hope for the future.
example.cn: 我初到纽约时，对未来充满希望。

enDef: the mass of things like fine threads that grows on your head

example.en: Her hair was short and dark.
example.cn: 她的头发又短又黑。

cn: 汉堡包，火腿汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉
enDef: a flat round piece of finely cut beef(= meat from a cow ) which is cooked and eaten in a bread bun
a small bag in which a woman carries money and personal things

example.en: I have sent  Tom back for your handbag.
example.cn: 我已经让汤姆回去取你的手提袋了。

cn: （男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的
enDef: a handsome amount of money is large

example.en: He managed to make a handsome profit out of the deal.
example.cn: 他从这笔买卖中赚取了丰厚的利润。

enDef: to make it possible or easier for someone to do something by doing part of their work or by giving them something they need

example.en: If there’s anything I can do to help, just give me a call.
example.cn: 如果需要我帮忙，就给我打个电话。

cn: 头；头痛；上端；最前的部分；理解力
enDef: the top part of your body that has your face at the front and is supported by your neck

example.en: He kissed the top of her head.
example.cn: 他吻了一下她的头顶。

cn: 健康的，健全的；有益于健康的
enDef: physically strong and not likely to become ill or weak

example.en: a healthy baby boy
example.cn: 健康的男婴

cn: 心脏；感情；勇气；心形；要点
enDef: the organ in your chest which pumps blood through your body

example.en: Regular exercise is good for the heart.
example.cn: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

enDef: warmth or the quality of being hot

example.en: Ice needs heat to melt.
example.cn: 冰需要热才能融化。

cn: 人的；人性的；有人情味的，有人性的
enDef: belonging to or relating to people, especially as opposed to machines or animals

example.en: There are many different cell types in the human body .
example.cn: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

enDef: providing useful help in making a situation better or easier

example.en: Thank you for your advice; it’s been very helpful.
example.cn: 谢谢你的建议，它非常有用。

enDef: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned

example.en: He bent and touched his mouth to hers.
example.cn: 他俯身吻她的嘴唇。

cn: 她自己（she的反身代词）；她亲自
enDef: used to show that the woman or girl who does something is affected by her own action

example.en: She cut herself on some broken glass.
example.cn: 碎玻璃把她割伤了。

cn: 高的；高级的；崇高的；高音调的
enDef: measuring a long distance from the bottom to the top

example.en: This is the highest mountain in Japan.
example.cn: 这是日本最高的山。

cn: 洞， 孔眼； 漏洞， 缺陷
enDef: an empty space in something solid

example.en: I began digging a hole for the plant.
example.cn: 我开始挖洞种那棵植物。

enDef: an area of land that is higher than the land around it, like a mountain but smaller

example.en: Their house is on a hill overlooking the sea.
example.cn: 他们的房子建在可以俯视大海的小山上。

cn: 历史，历史学；历史记录；来历
enDef: all the things that happened in the past, especially the political, social, or economic development of a nation

example.en: Throughout history the achievements of women have been largely ignored.
example.cn: 从古至今，妇女的成就都被大大地忽视了。

enDef: work that a student at school is asked to do at home

example.en: For homework, finish the exercise on page 14.
example.cn: 家庭作业是完成第14页的练习。

cn: [hummed-hummed, humming] 哼曲子； 发出嗡嗡声； 忙碌， 充满活力
enDef: to sing a tune by making a continuous sound with your lips closed

example.en: He began to hum a tune.
example.cn: 他开始哼唱一支曲子。

cn: 诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的
enDef: someone who is honest always tells the truth and does not cheat or steal

example.en: He was a hard-working, honest man.
example.cn: 他勤奋老实。

enDef: a large strong animal that people ride and use for pulling heavy things

example.en: a horse and cart
example.cn: 一辆马车

cn: 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的
enDef: wanting to eat something

example.en: I was cold, tired, and hungry.
example.cn: 我又冷，又累，又饿。

cn: 主人； 东道主； 节目主持人； 许多， 大量
enDef: someone at a party, meal etc who has invited the guests and who provides the food, drink etc

example.en: Our host greeted us at the door.
example.cn: 主人在门口迎接我们。

enDef: If you say that someone hungers for something or hungers after it, you are emphasizing that they want it very much

example.en: But Jules was not eager for classroom learning, he hungered for adventure.
example.cn: 但是朱尔斯并不热衷于课堂学习，他渴望冒险。

example.en: We should say and do nothing to the injury of any one. It is not only a matter of principle, but also the path of peace and honor.
example.cn: 任何有损他人的言语或者事情我们都应该避免。这不仅是一种做人的原则，而且也是通向平和的人际关系、获得他人尊敬之道。 。

enDef: a type of aircraft with large metal blades on top which turn around very quickly to make it fly

example.en: You can helicopter to the island.
example.cn: 你可以乘坐直升机去那个岛。

cn: 头痛； 令人头痛的人
enDef: a pain in your head

example.en: If you have a headache, you should take some aspirin.
example.cn: 要是头痛，你该吃点阿司匹林。

enDef: to injure yourself or someone else

example.en: Was anyone hurt in the accident?
example.cn: 事故中有人受伤吗？

enDef: the country where someone was born

example.en: Many are planning to return to their homeland.
example.cn: 很多人正计划回到自己的祖国去。

enDef: funny and enjoyable

example.en: humorous stories
example.cn: 诙谐的故事

cn: 走廊， 回廊； 门厅， 过道
enDef: the area just inside the door of a house or other building, that leads to other rooms

example.en: They took the lift up to the third floor and walked along the quiet hallway.
example.cn: 他们乘电梯到了3楼，然后走过寂静的过道。

enDef: used as a greeting when you see or meet someone

example.en: Hello, John! How are you?
example.cn: 喂，约翰！你好吗？

enDef: to deliberately put or keep something or someone in a place where they cannot easily be seen or found

example.en: She keeps a bottle of gin hidden behind a stack of books.
example.cn: 她在一堆书的后面藏了一瓶杜松子酒。

cn: [heard-heard] 听见； 听到， 得知； 审讯， 听证； 收到…的信
enDef: to know that a sound is being made, using your ears

example.en: Blanche heard a crash as the back door was flung open.
example.cn: 布兰奇听见后门哗啦一声被推开。

cn: 无家的， 无家可归的
enDef: without a home

example.en: Thousands of people have been made homeless .
example.cn: 成千上万人被逼得无家可归。

cn: 脚后跟， 踵； 后跟
enDef: the curved back part of your foot

example.en: black boots with high heels
example.cn: 有高跟的黑靴子

cn: 蜜， 蜂蜜； 甜蜜； 宝贝儿， 亲爱的
enDef: a sweet sticky substance produced by  bees  , used as food

example.en: Hi, honey.
example.cn: 嗨，亲爱的。

cn: 英雄， 勇士； 男主角， 男主人公
enDef: a man who is admired for doing something extremely brave

example.en: He had dared to speak out against injustice, and overnight he became a national hero .
example.cn: 他敢于站出来抨击不公正的现象，一夜之间就成了国家英雄。

cn: 快乐地；幸福地；幸运地；恰当地
enDef: in a happy way

example.en: Michelle smiled happily.
example.cn: 米歇尔高兴地笑了。

example.en: I know a number of parents have rung the headteacher about what has happened but I would appeal for everyone to be calm, particularly in relation to those people involved.
example.cn: 我知道一些家长正围着校长问事情发生的经过，但我呼吁大家要保持冷静，特别是在那些跟这件事有直接关系的人。

enDef: an area of water next to the land where the water is calm, so that ships are safe when they are inside it

example.en: as they sailed into Portsmouth Harbour
example.cn: 当他们驶入朴次茅斯港的时候

cn: 群居；入蜂房；生活在蜂房中
enDef: a place that is full of people who are very busy

example.en: This marketplace was once a hive of activity.
example.cn: 这个市场曾经熙熙攘攘。

cn: 兜售，沿街叫卖；捕捉；咳出
enDef: to try to sell goods, usually by going from place to place and trying to persuade people to buy them
the ability or tendency to think that things are funny, or funny things you say that show you have this ability

example.en: his humour and charm
example.cn: 他的幽默感和魅力

enDef: the title of a newspaper report, which is printed in large letters above the report

example.en: a paper carrying the front-page headline: ‘Space Aliens meet with President’
example.cn: 头版报道题为“天外来客会见总统”的报纸

cn: 女主人，女老板；女服务员；舞女；女房东
enDef: a woman at a party, meal etc who has invited all the guests and provides them with food, drink etc

example.en: The hostess introduced them.
example.cn: 女主人介绍了他们。

enDef: when people live or work together without fighting or disagreeing with each other

example.en: I do believe it is possible for different ethnic groups to live together in harmony.
example.cn: 我确信不同民族的人民可以融洽相处。

enDef: something that makes your life difficult or unpleasant, especially a lack of money, or the condition of having a difficult life

example.en: an economic policy that caused great hardship for many people
example.cn: 造成许多人贫困的经济政策

enDef: damage, injury, or trouble caused by someone’s actions or by an event

example.en: The scandal did his career a lot of harm.
example.cn: 丑闻对他的职业生涯造成很大损害。

cn: 没有希望的； 不可救药的
enDef: if something that you try to do is hopeless, there is no possibility of it being successful

example.en: We tried to stop the flames from spreading, but we knew it was hopeless.
example.cn: 我们试图阻止火势蔓延，但我们知道这是不可能的。

enDef: unable or unlikely to hurt anyone or cause damage

example.en: Her brother’s a bit simple, but he’s quite harmless.
example.cn: 她的弟弟有点愚钝，不过他决不会伤害别人。

enDef: causing harm

example.en: the harmful effects of smoking
example.cn: 吸烟的害处

enDef: if an egg hatches, or if it is hatched, it breaks, letting the young bird, insect etc come out

example.en: The eggs take three days to hatch.
example.cn: 这些蛋要三天时间才能孵化。

enDef: the time when crops are gathered from the fields, or the act of gathering them

example.en: The company is now reaping the harvest of careful planning.
example.cn: 公司现在尝到了精心规划带来的甜头。

enDef: Hydrogen is a colourless gas that is the lightest and commonest element in the universe

example.en: At the South Pole, in a region of continuous darkness, humans could access water to produce hydrogen and oxygen.
example.cn: 月球南极是一个持续黑暗的区域，在这里，人类能够接触到水，以生产氢和氧。

enDef: a strong hard hat that soldiers,  motorcycle  riders, the police etc wear to protect their heads

example.en: The bullet glanced off his helmet.
example.cn: 那颗子弹掠过他的头盔。

enDef: an arrangement in which you pay a sum of money to borrow something for a short time

example.en: a car hire company
example.cn: 汽车租赁公司

enDef: the sense which you use to hear sounds

example.en: a child with a hearing disability
example.cn: 有听力障碍的儿童

enDef: an amount that you can hold in your hand

example.en: There were only a handful of people there.
example.cn: 那里只有几个人。

enDef: something that you do regularly or usually, often without thinking about it because you have done it so many times before

example.en: Regular exercise is a good habit.
example.cn: 经常锻炼是个好习惯。

enDef: a wide main road that joins one town to another

example.en: Interstate Highway 75
example.cn: 75号州际公路

enDef: a married woman who works at home doing the cooking, cleaning etc, but does not have a job outside the house

example.en: Married at nineteen, she was a traditional housewife and mother of four children.
example.cn: 她19岁就结婚了，是个传统的家庭主妇和4个孩子的母亲。

enDef: to make a long loud cry because you are unhappy, angry, or in pain, or because you are amused or excited

example.en: Upstairs, one of the twins began to howl (= cry ) .
example.cn: 楼上，双胞胎中的一个开始大哭起来。

enDef: connected with God and religion

example.en: the holy city of Varanasi
example.cn: 圣城瓦拉纳西

enDef: the sloping side of a hill
to put your arms around someone and hold them tightly to show love or friendship

example.en: We stood there crying and hugging each other.
example.cn: 我们站在那里哭着互相拥抱。

enDef: a curved piece of metal or plastic that you use for hanging things on

example.en: Tom hung his coat on the hook behind the door.
example.cn: 汤姆把外套挂在门后的衣钩上。

enDef: when you have a haircut, someone cuts your hair for you

example.en: Do you like my new haircut?
example.cn: 你喜欢我的新发型吗？

enDef: to show publicly that someone is respected and admired, especially by praising them or giving them a special title

example.en: In a marriage, you need to honour one another.
example.cn: 婚姻中双方应该互相尊重。

enDef: a piece of cloth that you use for drying your nose or eyes

example.en: Before sweeping the house she bound up her hair in a large handkerchief.
example.cn: 打扫房屋前， 她把头发用一块大手帕扎起来。

enDef: a small plant that is used to improve the taste of food, or to make medicine

example.en: Sprinkle the dish with chopped fresh herbs.
example.cn: 在菜肴上撒些切碎的新鲜香草。

cn: 便利的； 手边的； 附近的
enDef: near and easy to reach

example.en: I always keep my gun handy just in case.
example.cn: 我总是随身带着枪以防万一。

enDef: to hit something with a hammer in order to force it into a particular position or shape

example.en: the sound of hammering and sawing
example.cn: 锤打和拉锯的声音

enDef: Your handwriting is your style of writing with a pen or pencil

example.en: The address was in Anna's handwriting.
example.cn: 这个地址是安娜的笔迹。

example.cn: 睡鼠从10月到5月冬眠。

enDef: one of the two parts on each side of your body between the top of your leg and your waist

example.cn: 由于受伤，他的事业受到了阻碍。

example.cn: 该地区的商业中心

example.cn: 住房条件差引起的健康问题

enDef: doing something from habit, and unable to stop doing it

example.cn: …一家叔叔曾经在那里卖五金器具和木材的店铺。

example.cn: 因为生长在极端环境中，沙漠兔子形成了独特的生物学构造，通过瘦长的四肢和超大的耳朵辐射多余的热量。

example.cn: 我们必须治理那些每年泛滥的河流。

example.cn: 那个冬天异常寒冷，所以他们提前走了。

example.cn: 他很快就对自己仓促作出的决定感到后悔了。

enDef: very bad, unpleasant, or unkind

example.cn: 都是那个可恶的人造的孽！

example.cn: 她脸上闪过十足的仇恨表情。

example.cn: 联合国总部

enDef: to make someone who is ill become healthy again, especially by using natural powers or prayer

example.cn: 自称可以治病的传道士

enDef: a system for making a room or building warm

example.cn: 我们想减少供暖与空调的开支。

enDef: a row of small bushes or trees growing close together, usually dividing one field or garden from another

example.cn: 琼森是他的政治接班人，他将担任该党派的领袖。

enDef: the place where the souls of bad people are believed to be punished after death, especially in the Christian and Muslim religions

example.cn: 战争是人间地狱。

example.cn: 他开始觉得沮丧、无助。

example.cn: 运输成本是企业的一大支出，因此工厂选址是重要的考虑因素。

example.cn: 乔贝还以其大群的大象和水牛而闻名。

example.cn: 她拯救家人的英勇行为

enDef: very

example.cn: 汤姆的母亲对学校的处理方法持强烈的批评态度。

example.cn: 历史名胜

enDef: having an empty space inside

example.cn: 空心树

example.cn: 我父亲认为当演员不是受人尊敬的职业。

example.cn: 远处小黑点般的一条小船出现在地平线上。

example.cn: 两百马力的发动机

example.cn: 小木屋

example.cn: 失业者并不都是同一类人。

example.cn: 具有历史意义的世界领导人会议

example.cn: 你没有关花园的水管。

example.cn: 他工作时喜欢唱赞美诗。

example.cn: 烟雾间出现了飞行员跌跌撞撞的身影，他的手笨拙地摸索着腰带上的手枪。

example.cn: 感谢你几周来的热情款待。

example.cn: 宗教价值观常常和人文主义道德观相去甚远。

example.cn: 一种假设是受害人开车时睡着了。

example.cn: 她探出窗户向一个路人大喊。

cn: 遗产； 继承物； 传统

example.cn: 保护民族遗产的重要性

enDef: the outer covering of seeds, rice, grain etc
to pull something heavy with a continuous steady movement

example.cn: 拖动火车的蒸汽机车

enDef: a chemical compound that consists of  hydrogen and carbon, such as coal or gas

example.cn: 碳氢化合物的排放

enDef: to move by jumping on one foot

example.cn: 一个蹦蹦跳跳的小女孩

example.cn: 水压泵，液压泵

example.cn: 她用手指划过竖琴的琴弦。

example.cn: 《小说写作手册》

example.cn: 房间的温度保持在72度，相对湿度50%。

example.cn: 必须依赖国家发放的救济金生活的人们

enDef: to raise, lift, or pull something up, especially using ropes

example.cn: 船员们急忙把旗子升起来。

enDef: someone who is kept as a prisoner by an enemy so that the other side will do what the enemy demands

example.cn: 这伙人挟持了两名游客作为人质。

enDef: dangerous, especially to people’s health or safety

example.cn: 有害废弃物的处理

enDef: strong and healthy and able to bear difficult living conditions

example.cn: 能适应恶劣环境的石山羊

enDef: up to this time

example.cn: 迄今在西方还不为人知的一种鱼

enDef: an honorary title, rank, or university degree is given to someone as an honour

example.cn: 布朗获得了首尔大学的荣誉博士学位。

example.cn: 示威者在向窗里掷砖块。

enDef: to stay nervously in the same place, especially because you are waiting for something or are not certain what to do

example.cn: 她的弟弟在后面走来走去，观察着我们。

example.cn: 该航班被一帮恐怖分子劫持。

enDef: when someone is unfriendly and full of anger towards another person

example.cn: 过去的10年里，种族主义及对黑人和少数民族的敌意变得更加严重了。

example.cn: 我是一位历史学家，在美国一所大学任教。

enDef: from this time on

example.cn: 多发性硬化（以下称为MS）

enDef: simple and good

example.cn: 家常烹调

enDef: a machine for making air or water hotter

example.cn: 你关掉加热器了吗？

example.cn: 有人担心这次游行会加深种族间的紧张局势。

example.cn: 这种装饰风格是传统与现代的和谐统一。

example.cn: 盖子在上好油的折叶上一下子弹开了。

enDef: a dog that is fast and has a good sense of smell, used for hunting

example.cn: 雷尼一生中的主要嗜好是带着猎犬去打猎。

example.cn: 她想跑，但沉重的旅行箱拖累了她。

example.cn: 这个慈善机构因为缺乏资金难以开展工作。

example.cn: 把马铃薯竖着切成两半。

example.cn: 人群突然变得鸦雀无声。

enDef: if the soul of a dead person haunts a place, it appears there often

example.cn: 据说这个酒吧里经常有一位前任房主的鬼魂出没。

cn: 等级制度； 统治集团， 领导层

example.cn: 严格的社会等级制度
